"'''Heroes and Hotshots / A Jedi or a Pirate'''" is the first episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 14]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Official description==
''A new Padawan arrives on Tenoo. Kai helps a youngling.''
